definition: Opening naturally when ripe, especially to release seeds, as a poppy capsule or milkweed pod.
etymology: It comes from Latin dehiscere, “to gape open”: de- suggests separation, and hiare means “to yawn” or “gape.” A dehiscent pod is, literally, one that has learned to open its mouth.
usage: By October, the dehiscent pods along the path had begun to split and scatter their silky cargo.
